description: This file defines the Tenant class, representing the schema and management logic for a Hono Tenant within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes properties such as enabled status, extensions, defaults, adapters, resource limits, tracing configurations, and trusted certificate authorities. The class provides getter and setter methods, validation, and utility functions related to tenant configuration.

classes.name: Tenant
classes.description: Represents a Hono Tenant with configuration properties such as enabled status, extensions, defaults, adapters, resource limits, tracing, and trust anchors. Provides methods for managing these properties and validation routines.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant's trusted certificate authorities are all valid.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether devices of this tenant should be able to connect.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether devices of this tenant are able to connect.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Replaces all extension properties of the tenant with the provided map.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an individual extension property.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the extension properties.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Replaces all default properties of the tenant.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the default properties.

methods.name: setAdapters
methods.description: Sets the list of adapters for the tenant, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of adapters.

methods.name: addAdapterConfig
methods.description: Adds an adapter configuration, ensuring no duplicate types.

methods.name: getMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Gets the minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: setMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum message size in bytes, validating non-negativity.

methods.name: getResourceLimits
methods.description: Returns the resource limits of the tenant.

methods.name: setResourceLimits
methods.description: Sets the resource limits for the tenant.

methods.name: getTracing
methods.description: Returns the tracing configuration of the tenant.

methods.name: setTracing
methods.description: Sets the tracing configuration.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the list of trusted certificate authorities.

methods.name: setTrustedCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Sets the list of trusted certificate authorities.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificateAuthoritySubjectDNs
methods.description: Returns the set of subject distinguished names for the trusted CAs.

methods.name: hasTrustedCertificateAuthoritySubjectDN
methods.description: Checks if the tenant trusts a CA with the specified subject DN.
